ops.oldText: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder, whether by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party.
ops.newText: Neither party may assign this Agreement or any rights or obligations hereunder, whether by operation of law or otherwise, without the prior written consent of the other party, which consent shall not be unreasonably withheld.

ops.oldText: the sale of all or substantially all of its assets related to this Agreement without such consent, except
ops.newText: the sale of all or substantially all of its assets related to this Agreement without such consent, upon written notice to the other party, except

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have qualified the mutual consent standard so that consent to other assignments may not be unreasonably withheld, and required written notice to the other party of a successor assignment under the existing merger/asset-sale carve-out. This is our fallback assignment position; the mutual carve-out and the competitor exception are otherwise unchanged.
proposal.summary: Make assignment consent subject to a reasonableness standard and require written notice of successor assignments

mappings.element: Customer right to assign to a successor.
